Installing loading required packages: Load PBMC4K dataset create ExperimentSubset object: Compute per-cell QC metrics counts matrix using scrapper library store total count (sum) cell: Filter cells low column sum create new subset called ‘filteredCells’: Normalize ‘filteredCells’ subset using scrapper library store back. Size factors computed cell’s total count centered one: Find highly variable genes normalized assay previous step using scrapper library ‘filteredCells’ subset : Run ‘PCA’ highly variable genes computed last step using scrapper library ‘hvg2000’ subset . runPca returns PCs rows, transpose put cells rows: Show current condition ExperimentSubset object:
code: if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))     install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install(c("TENxPBMCData", "scrapper")) library(ExperimentSubset) library(TENxPBMCData) library(scrapper) tenx_pbmc4k <- TENxPBMCData(dataset = "pbmc4k") es <- ExperimentSubset(tenx_pbmc4k) subsetSummary(es) qcMetrics <- computeRnaQcMetrics(assay(es, "counts"), subsets = list()) colData(es)$sum <- qcMetrics$sum filteredCellsIndices <- which(colData(es)$sum > 1500) es <- createSubset(es, subsetName = "filteredCells",                    cols = filteredCellsIndices, parentAssay = "counts") subsetSummary(es) filteredCounts <- assay(es, "filteredCells") filteredSizeFactors <- centerSizeFactors(colSums(filteredCounts)) normalizedCounts <- normalizeCounts(filteredCounts,                                     size.factors = filteredSizeFactors) assay(es, "filteredCells",       subsetAssayName = "filteredCellsNormalized") <- normalizedCounts subsetSummary(es) normalizedCounts <- assay(es, "filteredCells/filteredCellsNormalized") geneVariances <- modelGeneVariances(normalizedCounts) residualVariances <- geneVariances$statistics$residuals topHVG2000 <- chooseHighlyVariableGenes(residualVariances, top = 2000) es <- createSubset(es, subsetName = "hvg2000", rows = topHVG2000,                    parentAssay = "filteredCells/filteredCellsNormalized") subsetSummary(es) pcaResult <- runPca(assay(es, "hvg2000")) pcaScores <- t(pcaResult$components) reducedDim(es, type = "PCA", subsetName = "hvg2000") <- pcaScores subsetSummary(es)

title: A single-cell workflow with every subset in one object
text: Direct style. follow standard workflow scrapper package, storing result clean subset subset variable genes. Normalisation. Counts divided cell’s size factor log-transformed. delayed = FALSE computes values now, rather time read. Variable genes. choose 2,000 genes whose expression varies across clean cells, keep subset rows, clean.variable, made log-normalised values. Scaling. variable gene’s log-normalised values turned z-scores across clean cells: mean 0 standard deviation 1. variable genes scaled: go PCA, z-scores, rarely zero, take far memory sparse log-normalised values. z-scores stored clean.variable subset. PCA, clusters UMAP. keep first 25 principal components (scrapper’s default) z-scores. describe clean cells, store , clusters UMAP clean subset. runPca() returns one column per cell, layout scrapper functions take; reduced dimensions stored one row per cell, transpose storing. scrapper’s PCA, clustering UMAP use fixed seeds default, give results every run.
code: library(scrapper)  # decontaminated counts of the clean cells cleanCounts <- assay(es, "clean")  # size factors from each cell's total, then log-normalised values cellTotals <- colSums(cleanCounts) sizeFactors <- centerSizeFactors(cellTotals) lognormalized <- normalizeCounts(cleanCounts, sizeFactors, delayed = FALSE) es <- setSubsetAssay(es, subsetName = "clean",                      inputMatrix = lognormalized,                      subsetAssayName = "lognormalized") # variance of each gene, and the 2,000 most variable geneVariances <- modelGeneVariances(lognormalized) geneResiduals <- geneVariances$statistics$residuals variableGenes <- chooseHighlyVariableGenes(geneResiduals, top = 2000)  # the variable genes as a subset of rows es <- createSubset(es, subsetName = "clean.variable", rows = variableGenes,                    parentAssay = "clean/lognormalized") variableLognormalized <- assay(es, "clean.variable") dim(variableLognormalized) ## [1] 2000 3994 # z-scores of each variable gene; scale() works on columns, so we # transpose to one column per gene and back variableDense <- as.matrix(variableLognormalized) genesByColumn <- t(variableDense) scaledByColumn <- scale(genesByColumn) scaled <- t(scaledByColumn) es <- setSubsetAssay(es, subsetName = "clean.variable",                      inputMatrix = scaled,                      subsetAssayName = "scaled") # principal components of the z-scores of the variable genes pca <- runPca(scaled) cellPcs <- t(pca$components) reducedDim(es, "reduction.pca", subsetName = "clean") <- cellPcs # a nearest-neighbour graph of the cells, and its clusters neighbourGraph <- buildSnnGraph(pca$components) clusters <- clusterGraph(neighbourGraph)  # a two-dimensional UMAP embedding umap <- runUmap(pca$components) reducedDim(es, "embedding.umap", subsetName = "clean") <- umap
